full_text: MEMBER COMPLAINT FORM (IEHP COVERED). Inland Empire Health Plan, Rancho Cucamonga, CA 91729-1800. For questions call 1-855-433-4347 or TTY 711. Grievance Department Fax # (909) 890-5748. Form includes fields for Member Information, Submitter/Representative Information, and Nature of Complaint. Mentions right to file complaints with the Department of Managed Health Care (DMHC) at 1-888-466-2219 or TTY 1-877-688-9891 and requests for Independent Medical Review (IMR) at no cost to members.
